title: chore: rotate OpenRouter API key
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Rotates `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` in the encrypted development, staging, and production secret files.
- Keeps the secret change isolated from feature work.
- Does not deploy or revoke the previous credential.

Validation:
- New key authenticated successfully with OpenRouter.
- Paid text inference and the dedicated image API/provider route succeeded.
- All three SOPS files decrypt successfully and contain the validated key.
- Biome and `git diff --check` pass.

gist.headline: Fresh key, same hive
gist.blurb: The OpenRouter keyring got a quiet seasonal refresh across development, staging, and production. Polli checked the routes; the bees are still buzzing.
gist.summary: Rotated the OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the encrypted development, staging, and production SOPS secret files after validating paid text inference and the dedicated image-provider route.
gist.impact: OpenRouter-backed text and image-provider requests continue using a validated credential consistently across all three environments.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy key-rotation scene: Polli uses a tiny locksmith tool to place a fresh glowing key into three small labeled garden-server boxes for dev, staging, and prod, while code-plants and flowers grow around them. The key represents refreshed provider authentication, and the three boxes make the environment coverage visible without exposing any credential details.
